input: Find JCC, synagogue and other non-church faith communities with summer camps for kids for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville Jewish summer camp 2026 JCC synagogue

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Camp Ruach Jewish summer day camp welcomes children and teens of all backgrounds; summer 2027 begins June 14.

candidates.name: Camp Judaea
candidates.note: Jewish overnight programs for rising grades 2–11, plus one-day introductions for rising grades 1–4; 2027 dates announced.

candidates.name: Union for Reform Judaism — 6 Points Sports Academy
candidates.note: Jewish sports camp at Asheville School, including a counselor-in-training program; summer 2027 announced.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: Jewish sleepaway camp for ages 6–16; also offers weeklong horseback skills camps in summer 2027.
